title: Practice: The imperative: читай, пусть, давайте

exercises.why: As a harsh or abrupt form of an order: *Встать!* The negative imperative is, as a rule, in the imperfective aspect: *Берите! Возьмите! — Не берите!* The negative imperative in the perfective aspect has the meaning of a strict warning: *Не забудьте взять ключ! Здесь скользко, не упадите!* — DLI, Lessons 42 and 84.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
